mergewith.subtemplate:
<stateNode id="reassortmentRateCwR.alltrees" value="0.1" estimate="true" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="NonNegativeReal"/> <stateNode id="popSizeCwR.alltrees" value="1.0" estimate="true" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> <stateNode id="binomialProbCwR.alltrees" value="0.5" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="UnitInterval"/>
<stateNode id="networkCwR.alltrees" spec="coalre.simulator.SimulatedCoalescentNetwork" nSegments="1" enableSegmentTreeUpdate="false" estimate="true"> <reassortmentRate value="0.0" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> <populationModel spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.tree.coalescent.ConstantPopulation"> <popSize value="1.0" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> </populationModel>
<taxonSet spec="beast.base.evolution.alignment.TaxonSet" alignment="@$(n)"/> </stateNode>
<init id="segmentTreeInitializerCwR.t:$(n)" spec="coalre.network.SegmentTreeInitializer" network="@networkCwR.alltrees"> <segmentTree idref="Tree.t:$(n)"/> </init>
<prior spec="coalre.util.DummyTreeDistribution" id="CoalescentWithReassortmentDummy.t:$(n)" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/>
<prior spec="coalre.distribution.CoalescentWithReassortment" id="CoalescentWithReassortmentPrior.alltrees"> <reassortmentRate idref="reassortmentRateCwR.alltrees"/> <populationModel id="constantPopSizeCwR.alltrees" spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.tree.coalescent.ConstantPopulation"> <popSize idref="popSizeCwR.alltrees"/> </populationModel> <networkIntervals id="networkIntervalsCwR.alltrees" spec="coalre.distribution.NetworkIntervals"> <network idref="networkCwR.alltrees"/> <binomialProb idref="binomialProbCwR.alltrees"/> </networkIntervals> </prior>
<distribution id="popSizeCwRPrior.alltrees" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal" param="@popSizeCwR.alltrees"><M spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real" value="3.0"/><S spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="2.5"/></distribution>
<distribution id="reassortmentRateCwRPrior.alltrees" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogUniform" param="@reassortmentRateCwR.alltrees"><lower spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="1.0E-12"/><upper spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="1.0E12"/></distribution>
<distribution id="binomialProbCwRPrior.alltrees" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Uniform" param="@binomialProbCwR.alltrees" lower="0" upper="1"/>
<operator id="reassortmentRateCwRScale.alltrees" parameter="@reassortmentRateCwR.alltrees" scaleFactor="0.5" weight="1.0" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/>
<operator id="popSizeCwRScale.alltrees" parameter="@popSizeCwR.alltrees" scaleFactor="0.5" weight="1.0" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/>
<operator id="binomialProbCwRScale.alltrees" parameter="@binomialProbCwR.alltrees" scaleFactor="0.5" weight="1.0" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/>
<operator id="addRemoveReassortmentCwR.alltrees" spec="coalre.operators.AddRemoveReassortment" network="@networkCwR.alltrees" alpha="1.0" weight="5.0"/>
<operator id="addRemoveAndResimulate.alltrees" spec="coalre.operators.AddRemoveAndResimulate" coalescentWithReassortment="@CoalescentWithReassortmentPrior.alltrees" divertOneSegment="false" network="@networkCwR.alltrees" weight="50"/>
<operator id="divertSegmentCwR.alltrees" spec="coalre.operators.DivertSegmentAndResimulate" coalescentWithReassortment="@CoalescentWithReassortmentPrior.alltrees" network="@networkCwR.alltrees" weight="5.0"/>
<operator id="uniformNetworkCwR.alltrees" spec="coalre.operators.UniformNetworkNodeHeightOperator" network="@networkCwR.alltrees" weight="5.0"/>
<operator id="networkWideExchangeCwR.alltrees" spec="coalre.operators.NetworkExchangeAndResimulate" coalescentWithReassortment="@CoalescentWithReassortmentPrior.alltrees" network="@networkCwR.alltrees" isNarrow="false" weight="5.0"/>
<operator id="networkNarrowExchangeCwR.alltrees" spec="coalre.operators.NetworkExchangeAndResimulate" coalescentWithReassortment="@CoalescentWithReassortmentPrior.alltrees" network="@networkCwR.alltrees" isNarrow="true" weight="15.0"/>
<operator id="subNetworkSlideCwR.alltrees" spec="coalre.operators.SubNetworkLeap" network="@networkCwR.alltrees" weight="30.0"/>
<operator id="networkGibbsCwR.alltrees" spec="coalre.operators.GibbsOperatorAboveSegmentRoots" coalescentWithReassortment="@CoalescentWithReassortmentPrior.alltrees" network="@networkCwR.alltrees" weight="5.0"/>
<operator id="networkScaleCwR.alltrees" spec="coalre.operators.NetworkScaleOperator" network="@networkCwR.alltrees" weight="3.0" scaleFactor="0.1"/>
<operator id="networkScaleRootCwR.alltrees" spec="coalre.operators.NetworkScaleOperator" network="@networkCwR.alltrees" scaleRootOnly="true" weight="3.0" scaleFactor="0.5"/>
<operator id="networkUpDownCwR.alltrees" spec="coalre.operators.NetworkScaleOperator" network="@networkCwR.alltrees" weight="3.0" scaleFactor="0.1"/>
<log id="networkCwRStatsLogger.alltrees" spec="coalre.statistics.NetworkStatsLogger" network="@networkCwR.alltrees"/>
<logger id="networkCwRLogger.alltrees" spec="Logger" logEvery="10000" mode="tree" fileName="$(filebase).network.trees"> <log idref="networkCwR.alltrees"/> </logger>
